units.source_text: 鸟边野的广大原野上，拥满了各处送葬人和各寺院念佛僧众，几无隙地。

en.t: Across the broad fields of Toribeno, mourners from every quarter and monks chanting the nenbutsu from many temples crowded together, leaving almost no open space.

units.source_text: 桐壶院自不必说，藤壶皇后及东宫太子等的使者，以及其他诸人的使者，都来郑重地吊唁。

en.t: Needless to say, messengers came from the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor, and messengers from Empress Fujitsubo, the Crown Prince, and many others also arrived to offer solemn condolences.

units.source_text: 左大臣悲伤之极，两脚都站不起来，羞愧己身命穷，

en.t: The Minister of the Left was overwhelmed with grief, unable even to stand on his own feet, and ashamed that his life had reached such a wretched pass,

units.source_text: 啼啼哭哭地说：“老夫如此高龄，身逢逆事，以致匍匐难行，何命途之舛！”

en.t: and, sobbing bitterly, he said, "At my great age, to meet with such calamity that I can scarcely crawl along--how cruelly twisted my fate has been!"
When the people heard his words, there was no one who did not grieve and sigh.

units.source_text: 这葬仪隆重盛大，喧扰了一夜。

en.t: The funeral rites were solemn and magnificent, and their bustle continued through the night.

units.source_text: 到了将近破晓，大家只得告别了这无常的骨灰而归去。

en.t: As dawn drew near, everyone had no choice but to take leave of those impermanent ashes and go home.
